# Victoria Trees

> A map of the 35,125 trees on public land in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada, from 368 species, built from the City of Victoria's open tree data (last refreshed 2026-11-22). Each tree has its species, location, and usually its height and trunk diameter; species have native ranges, descriptions, the birds and other wildlife that use them and, for native trees, SENĆOŦEN names. Trees on private property aren't included.

## Pages

- [Map](https://victoriatrees.ca/): every tree; tap one for its details
- [Cherry blossom calendar](https://victoriatrees.ca/blossoms/): when Victoria's 21 blossom species usually flower and the streets and parks with the most
- [Tree species](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/): all species from most to least common, each with a page listing where it grows
- [Trees by neighbourhood](https://victoriatrees.ca/neighbourhoods/): species counts for each of the City's neighbourhoods
- [About](https://victoriatrees.ca/about/): sources, credits and the data downloads

## Data

- [trees.csv](https://victoriatrees.ca/data/trees.csv): one row per tree: latitude, longitude, species, common_name, botanical_name, height_m, trunk_diameter_cm, place, neighbourhood
- [trees.json](https://victoriatrees.ca/data/trees.json): what the map loads; `trees` rows are [latitude, longitude, species index, botanical name index, height m, trunk diameter cm, place index]

## Linking to the map

- `https://victoriatrees.ca/?species=<slug>` highlights a species, using the slug from its page's URL (eg. `prunus-x-yedoensis`); separate several with commas
- `&bounds=<west,south,east,north>` frames an area, in degrees

## Most common species

- [Garry oak (Quercus garryana)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/quercus-garryana/): 5,206 trees
- [Cherry plum (Prunus cerasifera)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/prunus-cerasifera/): 2,065 trees
- [Japanese cherry (Prunus serrulata)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/prunus-serrulata/): 2,017 trees
- [Douglas-fir (Pseudotsuga menziesii)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/pseudotsuga-menziesii/): 1,313 trees
- [Red maple (Acer rubrum)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/acer-rubrum/): 1,194 trees
- [Field elm (Ulmus carpinifolia)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/ulmus-carpinifolia/): 1,081 trees
- [Bigleaf maple (Acer macrophyllum)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/acer-macrophyllum/): 1,012 trees
- [Common hawthorn (Crataegus oxyacantha)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/crataegus-oxyacantha/): 988 trees
- [Horse-chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/aesculus-hippocastanum/): 793 trees
- [Common hornbeam (Carpinus betulus)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/carpinus-betulus/): 779 trees
- [Austrian pine (Pinus nigra)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/pinus-nigra/): 716 trees
- [Yoshino cherry (Prunus × yedoensis)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/prunus-x-yedoensis/): 698 trees
- [Red horse-chestnut (Aesculus × carnea)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/aesculus-x-carnea/): 672 trees
- [Paper birch (Betula papyrifera)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/betula-papyrifera/): 621 trees
- [Field maple (Acer campestre)](https://victoriatrees.ca/species/acer-campestre/): 582 trees
